correctness.rationale: Normalize a complex quadratic at its maximizing point so a+b+c=1. Parseval of its square gives exactly |a|^4+4|ab|^2+|b^2+2ac|^2+4|bc|^2+|c|^4. Strict convexity in complex coefficients gives unique minimizer; reflection plus conjugation force a=c=rho real, b=1-2rho. Direct expansion Q=70x^4-80x^3+36x^2-8x+1 and Q=840(x-2/7)^2+24/7>0 yield unique cubic stationary root rho. Independent high-precision root evaluation and symbolic derivative checks reproduce C=1/Q(rho)=4.38567264283198 and strict contraction (5Q(rho))^-1/4. Equality rotations and normalized Bergman moment ∫|u|^8=1/5 follow. Full proof, not eight finite rational checks, proves all complex polynomials.
